{{Short description|Type of reflecting prism}}
[[File:Bauernfeind-Prism angles 60deg.svg|thumb|Reflections in a Bauernfeind prism for 60 deg beam deviation. Green side requires reflective coating.]]
A '''Bauernfeind prism''' is a type of reflecting [[prism (optics)|prism]] used to deviate a beam of light by 45° to 60°, depending on its construction, while neither flipping nor rotating the image.<ref name="dorotek">{{cite web|url=http://www.dorotek.de/cms/upload/pdf/optik/deutsch/6-PRISMA.pdf|date=26 May 2009|title=6-PRISMA|author=Hanno Schmidt|accessdate=2015-03-22|archive-date=2014-01-07|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140107131803/http://www.dorotek.de/cms/upload/pdf/optik/deutsch/6-PRISMA.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref> It is named for its inventor, the German expert of [[geodesy]] [[Karl Maximilian von Bauernfeind]].<ref name="techniklexikon">{{cite web|url=http://www.techniklexikon.net/d/bauernfeind-prisma/bauernfeind-prisma.htm|title=Bauernfeind-Prisma - Techniklexikon|author=Techniklexikon.net|publisher=techniklexikon.net|accessdate=2015-03-22}}</ref>

The beam is reflected twice in the prism, with one reflection happening at less than the [[total internal reflection|critical angle]].  Therefore, the prism requires a [[Mirror|reflective coating]] for this surface to be usable in practice.

A Bauernfeind prism with 45° beam deviation is also known as a '''half-penta prism''' or '''semipentaprism'''.<ref name="edmundoptics">{{cite web|url=http://www.edmundoptics.com/optics/prisms/image-rotation-prisms/half-penta-prisms/3249|title=www.edmundoptics.com/optics/prisms/image-rotation-prisms/half-penta-prisms/3249|publisher=edmundoptics.com|accessdate=2015-03-22}}</ref><ref name="tecplusplus">{{cite web|url=http://www.tecplusplus.de/ManualLu/prisms.htm|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030510122357/http://www.tecplusplus.de/ManualLu/prisms.htm|archive-date=2003-05-10|url-status=dead|title=VOB Lumex -- Prisms|accessdate=2015-03-22}}</ref> A Bauernfeind prism is used together with a [[Schmidt roof prism]] to form a [[Schmidt–Pechan prism]].

== Applications ==
The Bauernfeind prism is commonly used in [[microscope]] tubes and in geodesy to deviate the path to the [[eyepiece]] in order make the device more ergonomic.<ref>{{Google books |id=K0H9tYuaQH4C |page=475 |title=Optik: Physikalisch-technische Grundlagen und Anwendungen }} {{in lang|de}}</ref>

More recent applications are glasses that deflect the viewing angle either downwards (for relaxed reading or watching TV<ref name="rehadat-hilfsmittel">{{cite web|url=http://www.rehadat-hilfsmittel.de/de/kommunikation-information/sehhilfen/liegebrillen/index.html|title=Prismenbrillen, Liegebrillen, Teleskopspiegel - REHADAT-Hilfsmittel|publisher=rehadat-hilfsmittel.de|accessdate=2015-03-22|archive-date=2013-12-13|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131213054437/http://www.rehadat-hilfsmittel.de/de/kommunikation-information/sehhilfen/liegebrillen/index.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>), or upwards (as in [[belay glasses]] for watching a climber while belaying).
